title: The Peanuts Family Christmas Movie Night
description: A Peanuts family Christmas movie night from Sam's Club: matching Snoopy red plaid pajamas for mom and girls, a Snoopy dog bandana, a Peanuts Home for the Holidays faux fur throw, Garrett Mix popcorn and Swiss Miss marshmallow hot cocoa.
intro: A Charlie Brown Christmas is not optional in my house. It's the law. So movie night gets the full treatment: matching red plaid Snoopy pajamas for mom and the girls, a matching Snoopy bandana so the dog doesn't feel left out, a soft Peanuts Home for the Holidays throw for the couch pile, a big bag of Garrett Mix because caramel plus cheddar is the correct answer, and a 50 count box of Swiss Miss with marshmallows so nobody fights over the last packet. Snacks, pajamas, Snoopy. Done.

sections.heading: Matching for the whole crew
paragraphs: The Character Women's Family Sleep pajama set in Peanuts, the Character Girls Family Sleep nightgown in Peanuts, and the Character Pet Family Sleep bandana in Peanuts, all in the same red plaid Snoopy print.

sections.heading: The couch and the snacks
paragraphs: The Peanuts Home for the Holidays 50 by 60 inch silk touch faux fur throw, Garrett Popcorn Shops Garrett Mix in the 20 ounce bag, and Swiss Miss Marshmallow hot cocoa mix in the 50 count box.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The family room, the tree and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
